mobbin:b0cb149f-d742-4d9e-a22f-5dfe5d15b.summary: From Workspace Import, user chooses CSV, uploads a file, maps CSV headers to property types with a live table preview, and lands on a new database page of imported rows.
steal: Copy states create new DB or merge into existing (steps 2–3) — call out merge path for re-import.
'Use first row as headers' toggle + property-type dropdowns beside live preview (step 4).
Immediate typed database result page after Import CSV (step 5).
avoid: This capture shows create-new only; no error/duplicate-resolution UI or matching-key picker on screen — thin for bulk schedule re-imports.
mobbin:b0cb149f-d742-4d9e-a22f-5dfe5d15b.fit: Lightweight CSV→typed table path for first-time roster ingest; Essentials still needs Attio-like create/update preview and error resolution for master-file updates.

mobbin:601c6b07-ab5a-4a8b-8dfa-7f2d39b09.summary: From Meetings sidebar, user connects Google or iCloud calendar, then sees upcoming events with Join/Transcribe, Meet link, participants, and Open in calendar.
steps: Event menu — Meet link, Open in calendar
steal: Connect CTA embedded where events will appear (step 0), not only in settings.
Post-connect sidebar surfaces events with Join / Open in calendar (steps 3–5) — proves what synced.
Modal copy: AI notes + schedule via Notion AI (step 1) — states product purpose of the sync.
avoid: Flow does not show write-back rules, conflict handling, or Outlook — insufficient alone as Essentials Outlook sync model.
